build.description: GPUI native desktop build. Cargo writes the binary under the repo-root .cargo-target (root .cargo/config.toml), managed by Cargo's own incremental cache and intentionally not declared as a Turbo output, so this task opts out of Turbo caching like apps/desktop.

bundle.description: Installers for this OS through cargo-packager ([package.metadata.packager] in Cargo.toml), under the repo-root .cargo-target/release/bundle/native. Output sits outside the workspace, so the task never caches.

format:check.description: cargo fmt reads the root rustfmt.toml and toolchain pin; prettier reads the shared config.

lint.description: cargo clippy reads the workspace lints, clippy.toml, the lockfile and the toolchain pin, so they are inputs beside the shared ESLint presets.

typecheck.description: cargo check reads the workspace manifest, the lockfile and the toolchain pin.

test.description: cargo test reads the workspace files; the vitest contract test reads the root Cargo.toml.
